verdicts.reason: A: the RSVP button has shrunk to the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills, so the CTA is buried in a row of badges. The logo wordmark looks broken ('SOLST CE'), the tagline is stuck in a narrow centre column wedged between the headline and the date, and the legal text and partner mark are tiny scraps in the corner, so the layout is jumbled. B: it uses clear columns (brand and headline, then date, then pills and RSVP), and the CTA stands out. However, the headline is fairly small and competes with the RSVP button, the can graphic floats loosely in the middle, the legal line sits right on the bottom edge, and the missing-asset placeholder is clearly visible.
